name: airsql
description: Work with your MySQL and MariaDB databases through AirSQL, the Mac app: schemas, read-only queries, profiles, proposed SQL.
long_description: AirSQL is a native Mac app for MySQL and MariaDB. This bundle starts AirSQL's own MCP server (`AirSQL --mcp`), which talks to the AirSQL running on this Mac. It needs AirSQL installed and **AirSQL ▸ Settings ▸ Agents ▸ Allow AI agents to use AirSQL** turned on; each connection's access (Off, Schema, Schema + read, Schema + read + analytics) is chosen there, and connections start at Off. Agents never see passwords and can't change data: their statements must be provably read-only and run in a read-only transaction on a read-only session, and changes are proposed in a console tab for the person to run.
